channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: War culus: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh oo si aan horay loo arag u weeraray Imaaraadka Carabta – “Faragelintiisa waa khatar ku soo wajahan qarannimada Soomaaliya”
item.description: Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ayaa khudbad uu caawa u jeediyay shacabka ku eedeeyay Imaaraadka Carabta inuu faragelin toos ah ku hayo arrimaha gudaha Soomaaliya, isla markaana uu wiiqayo midnimada iyo madax-bannaanida dalka.

item.title: Madaxweyne Samia oo Philip Mpango u magacaabay guddoomiyaha Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine
item.description: Madaxweynaha Tanzania Samia Suluhu Hassan ayaa Madaxweyne ku-xigeenkii hore Dr Philip Mpango u magacaabay Chancellor-ka (guddoomiyaha sare) ee Jaamacadda Beeraha ee Sokoine (SUA), taasoo qayb ka ah magacaabisyo dhowr ah oo maanta lagu dhawaaqay.

item.title: Robinho Junior oo laba gool u dhaliyay Brazil U20 oo Peru ku garaacday 9-0
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka Genoa Robinho Junior, oo ah wiilka weeraryahankii hore ee Brazil Robinho, ayaa laba gool dhaliyay kulan saaxiibtinimo oo xulka Brazil ee da'da ka yar 20 jirka uu Peru kaga adkaaday 9-0.

item.title: Tiger Woods oo bisha soo socota dib ugu soo laabanaya tartamada golf-ka
item.description: Tiger Woods ayaa ka qayb geli doona tartanka Hero World Challenge ee ka dhacaya Bahamas 3 ilaa 6 December, isagoo markii ugu horreysay ciyaari doona tan iyo xarigiisii bishii March.

item.title: Alexander Zverev oo wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo cusub oo ay ka gudbisay xaaskiisii hore
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka tennis-ka Jarmalka Alexander Zverev ayaa wajahaya dacwad madani ah oo ay ka gudbisay Brenda Patea, oo ah hooyada gabadhiisa, kadib hadal uu ka sheegay kiiskii hore ee lagu eedeeyay rabshad qoys.

item.title: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda oo amartay doorasho cusub oo Ururka Qareennada ah 14 maalmood gudahood
item.description: Maxkamadda Sare ee Uganda ayaa go'aamisay in muddada xilka ee golaha hoggaanka Ururka Qareennada Uganda (ULS), oo uu hoggaamiyo Isaac Ssemakadde, ay dhammaatay, waxayna amartay in shir guud iyo doorasho cusub la qabto 14 maalmood gudahood.

item.title: Mike Maignan oo baaritaan kadib laga waayay dhaawac culus, Milan oo neefsatay
item.description: Kooxda AC Milan ayaa shaacisay in baaritaanno caafimaad oo maanta lagu sameeyay goolhayaha Mike Maignan aysan muujin wax dhaawac ah oo ku yaal muruqyada gumaarka iyo bowdada gudaha.

item.title: Wayne Rooney oo sheegay inuu xilligii uu Manchester United joogay la halgamayay caafimaadka maskaxda
item.description: Kabtankii hore ee xulka England Wayne Rooney ayaa barnaamij podcast ah ku sheegay in xilli uu ciyaaryahan ka ahaa Manchester United uu la kulmay dhibaatooyin culus oo xagga caafimaadka maskaxda ah, khamri cabbid iyo go'doomin.

item.title: Ingiriiska oo cunaqabateyn saaray 8 shirkadood oo Israa'iili ah oo dhisa degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed
item.description: Dowladda Ingiriiska ayaa Talaadadan xayiraad hanti saartay sideed shirkadood oo dhismeed oo Israa'iili ah oo ku lug leh dhismaha degsiimooyinka Daanta Galbeed ee la haysto, iyo koox degeyaal ah oo hor istaagta gargaarka loo diro Gaza.

item.title: Sevilla oo dharbaaxo cusub la kulantay: José Ángel Carmona oo lugta ka jabay
item.description: Kooxda Sevilla ayaa Talaadadan xaqiijisay in daafaceeda José Ángel Carmona uu ka jabay lafaha tibia iyo perone ee lugta midig, kadib shil uu ku dhaawacmay tababarka.

item.title: Bryson DeChambeau oo ku biiray DP World Tour kadib burburka LIV Golf
item.description: Xiddigga golf-ka ee Mareykanka Bryson DeChambeau ayaa sannadka soo socda ku ciyaari doona DP World Tour, kadib markii LIV Golf ay ku dhawaaqday inay joojinayso hawlaheeda.

item.title: Hashim Thaçi oo lagu xukumay 17 bilood oo dheeraad ah kadib markii lagu helay faragelin markhaatiyaal
item.description: Maxkamad gaar ah oo ku taal The Hague ayaa madaxweynihii hore ee Kosovo Hashim Thaçi ku xukuntay 17 bilood oo xarig dheeraad ah, kadib markii lagu helay inuu isku dayay inuu saameeyo markhaatiyaasha xeer-ilaalinta iyo inuu faafiyay xog qarsoodi ah.

item.title: Endrick iyo xaaskiisa Gabriely oo helay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Weeraryahanka reer Brazil Endrick ayaa ku dhawaaqay in xaaskiisa Gabriely ay dhashay ilmahoodii ugu horreeyay, isagoo warkan ku sheegay warbaahinta kadib kulankii Brazil iyo Singapore.

item.title: Kiiska Denis Bergamini: maxkamadda racfaanka oo xaqiijisay xukunka 16 sano ee gabadhii uu saaxiibka la ahaa
item.description: Maxkamadda Racfaanka ee Catanzaro ee dalka Talyaaniga ayaa xaqiijisay xukun 16 sano oo xarig ah oo lagu riday Isabella Internò, oo ahayd saaxiibaddii hore ee ciyaaryahankii Cosenza Denis Bergamini, kaas oo dhintay 18 November 1989.

item.title: Apple oo maxkamad Faransiiska ah la horkeeni doonaa 2027 eedeymo la xiriira iPhone
item.description: Shirkadda tignoolajiyada Mareykanka ee Apple ayaa bisha June 2027 maxkamad la horkeeni doonaa dalka Faransiiska, iyadoo lagu eedeeyay hab loo yaqaan duugoobid qorsheysan (planned obsolescence) oo saameeya dhowr nooc oo iPhone ah.

item.title: Riccardo Calafiori oo magaalada Roma sharfay, kuna sheegay inuu jeclaan lahaa inuu ku laabto Roma
item.description: Duqa magaalada Roma Roberto Gualtieri ayaa daafaca Arsenal iyo xulka Talyaaniga Riccardo Calafiori ku soo dhaweeyay xarunta Campidoglio, wuxuuna u gudoonsiiyay abaalmarin gaar ah oo loogu talagalay guulihiisa.

item.title: Kenan Yildiz oo kubbad la tababaray markii ugu horreysay tan iyo dhaawiciisii
item.description: Xiddigga Juventus Kenan Yildiz ayaa dib ugu soo laabtay garoonka tababarka ee Continassa isagoo kubbad la shaqeynaya, kadib ku dhowaad saddex bilood oo uu dhaawac cagta ah ku maqnaa.

item.title: Wissam Ben Yedder oo ku biiray Paris 13 Atlético ee Ligue 3
item.description: Weeraryahankii hore ee AS Monaco iyo xulka Faransiiska, Wissam Ben Yedder oo 36 jir ah, ayaa heshiis la galay kooxda Paris 13 Atlético ee ka ciyaarta Ligue 3, heerka saddexaad ee kubbadda Faransiiska, sida ay werisay L'Équipe.

item.title: Layvin Kurzawa oo 34 jir ku joojiyay ciyaaraha kubbadda cagta
item.description: Daafaca bidixda ee hore u ciyaari jiray Paris Saint-Germain iyo xulka Faransiiska, Layvin Kurzawa, ayaa ku dhawaaqay inuu ka fariistay kubbadda cagta xirfadeed isagoo 34 jir ah.

item.title: Faraska So You Are oo ka qeyb galay Melbourne Cup oo meydkiisa laga helay weel qashin
item.description: Meydka faraska tartanka ee So You Are, oo dhawaan ka qeyb galay tartanka caanka ah ee Melbourne Cup ee Australia, ayaa laga helay weel qashin oo yaalla goob qashinka lagu shubo, waxaana la bilaabay baaritaan.

item.title: Soomaaliya iyo Sacuudiga oo iskaashi ka yeelanaya la-dagaallanka fikirka xagjirka ah
item.description: Ra'iisul Wasaaraha Soomaaliya Xamsa Cabdi Barre ayaa Talaadadii Muqdisho kula kulmay wafdi Sacuudi ah oo uu hoggaaminayo madaxa Xarunta Ilaalinta Fikirka iyo Ka-hortagga Xagjirnimada, Cabdullaahi bin Haadi Al-Haajiri.

item.title: Dani Ceballos oo laga shakisan yahay kulanka derby-ga ee Betis iyo Sevilla
item.description: Khadka dhexe ee Real Betis Dani Ceballos ayaa laga shakisan yahay inuu ka qeyb galo kulanka derby-ga ee Sabtida ay kooxdu la ciyaarayso Sevilla, kadib markii uusan Talaadada la tababaran kooxda, sida ay werisay Mundo Deportivo iyo AS.

item.title: Costa Rica: Wariye caan ah oo ka warbixin jiray ka ganacsiga daroogada oo la toogtay
item.description: Wariyaha madaxa-bannaan ee Costa Rica Camilo Rodríguez, oo 50 jir ahaa, ayaa Isniintii lagu toogtay waddo weyn oo ku taalla Santo Domingo de Heredia, meel u dhow caasimadda San José.

item.title: Wiegman oo shaacisay liiska England ee ciyaarta go'aanka ah ee Ukraine, Goodwin oo markii ugu horreysay loo yeeray
item.description: Tababaraha xulka haweenka England, Sarina Wiegman, ayaa magacawday 25 ciyaartoy oo u diyaar ah ciyaarta isreebreebka Koobka Adduunka ee ay la ciyaarayaan Ukraine, iyadoo weeraryahanka London City Lionesses Izzy Goodwin markii ugu horreysay loo yeeray xulka.

item.title: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Soomaaliya oo digniin culus u diray mucaaradka: Ma sii adkaanayaan wada-hadalladii siyaasadeed?
item.description: Wasiirka Cadaaladda Xasan Macallin ayaa ku eedeeyay siyaasiyiinta mucaaradka inay qabiil ku gabbanayaan, wuxuuna ka digay in tallaabo laga qaadi doono kuwa siyaasadda ku adeegsanaya magaca beelaha.

item.title: Markab gaas qaada oo ka quustay xeebta Bulgaria, maalin kadib markabkii Betul 8
item.description: Markabka gaaska LPG qaada ee Gas Husky, oo calanka Liberia sita, ayaa Talaadadii ku quustay badda Madow gudaha aagga dhaqaale ee Bulgaria, maalin kadib markii markabka badeecadaha ee Betul 8, oo calanka Soomaaliya sita, uu isla aaggaas ku quustay.

item.title: Brazil oo 7-0 ku jabisay Singapore, Vinícius oo dhaliyay saddex gool
item.description: Xulka Brazil ee uu tababaro Carlo Ancelotti ayaa ciyaar saaxiibtinimo oo ka dhacday Singapore 7-0 ugu garaacday xulka dalkaas, iyadoo Vinícius Júnior uu dhaliyay saddex gool 12 daqiiqo gudahood.

item.title: Tony Mowbray oo xilka tababaraha Blackburn Rovers ka degay arrimo caafimaad awgood
item.description: Tababaraha kooxda Blackburn Rovers ee horyaalka Championship-ka England, Tony Mowbray, ayaa Talaadadii sheegay inuu xilkiisa ka dhinac maraayo sababo la xiriira caafimaadkiisa.

item.title: Shan urur oo deegaanka difaaca oo FIFA uga cabanaya Qaramada Midoobay arrimaha cimilada
item.description: Shan urur oo difaaca deegaanka ayaa cabasho wadajir ah u gudbiyay Qaramada Midoobay, iyagoo ku tilmaamay waxqabadka FIFA ee arrimaha cimilada mid "musiibo ah", sida ay werisay The Guardian, oo ay xigteen L'Équipe iyo RMC Sport.

item.title: Taageere Oviedo ah oo 11 bilood oo xabsi ah lagu xukumay cunsuriyad loo geystay Mbappé
item.description: Maxkamadda gobolka Asturias ee Spain ayaa Talaadadii taageere kooxda Oviedo ah ku xukuntay 11 bilood oo xabsi ah, kadib markii lagu helay inuu Kylian Mbappé u geystay aflagaado cunsuriyad ah ciyaar La Liga ah oo dhacday August 2025.
